# Brand assets

The shield has two halves: solid for security, redaction bars for privacy.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `logo-light.svg` | Horizontal logo for light backgrounds |
| `logo-dark.svg` | Horizontal logo for dark backgrounds |
| `mark.svg` | Shield alone, on a transparent background |
| `mark-512.png` | Shield alone, for avatars |
| `social-preview.png` | 1280×640 card for the repository's social preview |

| Colour | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Teal | `#0EA58F` | Security half |
| Amber | `#F7A600` | Privacy half, ampersand on dark |
| Dark amber | `#C98700` | Ampersand on light |
| Ink | `#0B1626` | Text on light, card background |

The wordmark is Sora SemiBold, converted to outlines, so no font is needed to display it. Sora and the card's Manrope are licensed under the SIL Open Font License.
